test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)

question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Sandwitch** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**sandwich**". • The correct pronunciation is "**sand-wich**". • The word refers to a food item consisting of two slices of bread with a filling between them. (ब्रेड के दो टुकड़े होते हैं जिनके बीच में भरावन होता है) • **Example**: *For lunch, I enjoyed a delicious turkey and cheese sandwich.* Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • '**Tour**' is spelt correctly and refers to a trip or journey taken for pleasure or education. (आनंद या शिक्षा के लिए की गई यात्रा या यात्रा) • '**Triumph**' is spelt correctly and refers to a great victory or achievement. (एक महान विजय या उपलब्धि) • '**Process**' is spelt correctly and refers to a series of actions taken to achieve a particular goal or result. (किसी विशेष लक्ष्य या परिणाम को प्राप्त करने के लिए की गई कार्रवाइयों की एक श्रृंखला) 154:T4de,The correct answer is: **By 2040, the Indian government will have controlled the growing population of India.**
